# Getting help

- **Common problems:** see [Help and troubleshooting](../README.md) in the README, for example SmartScreen, Windows
  Defender and macOS warnings.
- **Game crashes:** use the crash help in the launcher to find and share the crash report, then open a
  [bug report](https://github.com/SpectraLauncher/Launcher/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) with the link.
- **Bugs:** open a [bug report](https://github.com/SpectraLauncher/Launcher/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) with your
  launcher logs.
- **Ideas:** open a [feature request](https://github.com/SpectraLauncher/Launcher/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **Security issues:** follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md).

Spectra Launcher is not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft. Problems with the game itself, your Microsoft account or a
specific mod belong with their authors.
